data.one_liner: CLI tool to generate optimized service workers and bootstrap for Flutter Web
data.what_it_does: A command-line tool that replaces Flutter's default web bootstrap and service worker with a customizable loading pipeline, progress tracking, intelligent caching, and CanvasKit CDN loading. It analyzes the build directory, scans files, and creates an optimized resource manifest.
use_when: You are building a Flutter Web application and need advanced service worker caching and offline capabilities
You want a custom loading experience with progress tracking and stall detection for Flutter Web
avoid_when: You are running local development with `flutter run` (which handles its own bootstrap)
Your project does not target Flutter Web
strengths: Replaces default Flutter web bootstrap with a controlled initialization pipeline
Smart resource categorization and hash-based cache busting
Automatic file scanning and version management
weaknesses: Requires manual configuration of server Cache-Control headers
Needs two separate index.html templates for dev and production workflows
data.setup_notes: Activate via dart pub global activate sw, add production index.html template, and configure web server headers for no-cache.
